reason: Generates daily, weekly, monthly, or range-based reports from local DeepSeek Harness sessions, saves them as Markdown, and optionally syncs them to flomo with scheduled reminders.

summaries.zh: 从本地 DeepSeek Harness 会话生成日、周、月或自定义日期范围报告，保存为 Markdown 并可同步到 flomo。
summaries.en: Generate daily, weekly, monthly, or custom-range reports from local DeepSeek Harness sessions, save them as Markdown, and optionally sync them to flomo.

capabilities: Reads local DeepSeek Harness session data from ~/.dsh/sessions
Aggregates session messages, tool calls, token usage, and related metadata
Uses the deployment's default model to generate narrated reports
Writes Markdown reports to a configurable local directory
Sends generated report content to a configurable flomo incoming webhook
Displays system notifications for scheduled report reminders
